value.body: A livestock farm veterinarian keeps herds and flocks healthy and productive on commercial farms. Dairy farms, dairy cooperatives, poultry integrators and large livestock units hire them. Work focuses on herd health rather than single patients — vaccination plans, biosecurity, breeding, nutrition and treating outbreaks.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: BVSc & AH, with veterinary council registration

items.label: Work setting
items.value: On farms, often in rural areas, with on-call duty

items.label: Milk production
items.source: DAHD, Basic Animal Husbandry Statistics (as reported)

items.label: Egg production
items.source: DAHD, Basic Animal Husbandry Statistics 2024 (as reported)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually join a dairy cooperative, poultry integrator or commercial farm as a farm veterinarian or veterinary officer, sometimes after an internship there during the degree.

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: senior veterinarian, herd health manager, technical or production manager.
Disease outbreaks can bring intense work periods.
An MVSc in a specialty (for example, medicine or reproduction) supports advanced roles.

competition.note: BVSc & AH graduates in 2023-24 at institutions that reported to AISHE — everyone finishing that degree, not only those entering this role.
competition.source: AISHE 2023-24, Table 34 (programme-wise out-turn), Ministry of Education
